name: read_file
description: Read a text file from the workspace and return its contents. If you are not sure of the path, call list_files first.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root, for example calc.py

name: write_file
description: Create a file or replace a whole file. For a small change to an existing file, use edit_file instead.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root

content.description: The complete new contents of the file

name: edit_file
description: Replace one exact piece of text in a file. old_text must appear exactly once in the file; include a few surrounding lines to make it unique.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root

old_text.description: The exact text to replace, copied from the file

new_text.description: The text to put in its place

name: list_files
description: List every file in the workspace, one path per line, sorted.

name: run_command
description: Run a command in the workspace and return its output. Supported here: pytest, pytest -q, ls, and cat <path>.

cmd.description: The command line, for example pytest -q
